summary: Anchored the composer in empty/loading threads by giving the thread-empty and transcript-skeleton blocks flex:1 in conversation.css, then committed the CSS-only fix as abfa639 with passing checks and tests. Afterwards, explored refactoring Gizmo extensions to be built on top of Pi extensions: documented a proposal where Pi extensions are the backend/source of truth and Gizmo web entries become optional presentation companions, including a registerGizmoBackend bridge, session-scoped transport, and a generic Pi ctx.ui mapping.
decisions: Anchor the composer with CSS only by adding flex:1 to [data-ui='thread-empty'] and [data-ui='transcript-skeleton'] in apps/app/src/styles/conversation.css rather than restructuring layout markup.

Treat Pi extensions as the backend/source of truth for future extensions; Gizmo web entries become optional browser companions for inspector tabs, tool-result renderers, status bars, settings, dialogs, and notifications only.

Expose arbitrary browser RPC from Pi extensions via a new @gizmo/pi-web registerGizmoBackend(pi, { id, operations, subscriptions }) helper that initially talks over a shared Pi events bus to a hidden Gizmo host extension, avoiding Pi core changes.

Move extension transport from project-scoped to session-scoped messages: session.extensions.list, session.extension.invoke, session.extension.subscribe, session.extension.event, session.extensions.changed, because Pi extensions are recreated on reload/session switch/fork/resume/new thread.

Implement generic ctx.ui bridges for Gizmo (notify, confirm, select, input, editor, setStatus, setWidget) so most Pi extensions work in Gizmo without custom frontend code; terminal-only primitives degrade gracefully.

Define companion activation rules: activate only when matching Pi backend is loaded in the active session, apiVersion is compatible, the package is trusted, and the web bundle loads; a broken web bundle must never disable the Pi backend.

Use the @gizmo/git extension as the pilot migration: move defaultTools to pi.registerTool, move status/commit into registerGizmoBackend, start watcher on session_start, stop on session_shutdown, keep ChangesPanel.svelte but switch to the session extension host, then remove the gizmo.extensions.json entry.
Final migration ends with removal of GizmoServerExtension, ExtensionHostService, and gizmo.extensions.json, and narrowing the frontend host so extensions no longer receive the entire AgentStore.
